verdict.rationale: Stripe documents official first-party SDKs for agent and LLM work: the stripe/ai repo's SDK collection (@stripe/ai-sdk, @stripe/token-meter, @stripe/agent-toolkit) and the mppx SDK used alongside the `stripe` npm package. The core of the story is clearly delivered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the general-purpose language SDK catalog (e.g., per-language server libraries and their coverage), and independent hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: a collection of SDKs to help you integrate Stripe with LLMs and agent frameworks
@stripe/ai-sdk - for integrating Stripe's billing infrastructure with Vercel's ai and @ai-sdk libraries.
Use these files to generate SDKs or client libraries that support Stripe's API.
